name: persian-writing
description: Makes Claude write correct Persian: half-space (ZWNJ), Persian ی/ک instead of Arabic ي/ك, optional Persian digits and «» quotes, with a /persian command

enabled.title: Persian writing rules
enabled.description: Add the Persian writing rules to Claude's system prompt

zwnj.title: Half-space (ZWNJ)
zwnj.description: Ask Claude to write the half-space (U+200C) in می‌خواهم, کتاب‌ها, بزرگ‌تر and similar words

yehKaf.title: Persian ی and ک
yehKaf.description: Ask Claude to use Persian ی (U+06CC) and ک (U+06A9), never Arabic ي (U+064A) and ك (U+0643)

digits.title: Persian digits
digits.description: Ask Claude to write ۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹ in Persian prose (code, URLs and math keep 0-9)

quotes.title: Guillemets «»
quotes.description: Ask Claude to quote Persian text with «» instead of straight quotes
